text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan

Putrajaya (Ubah Suaian Akta Perhutanan Negara 1984) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2018.

Ubah suaian Akta ke Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

NATIONAL FORESTRY ACT 1984

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF PUTRAJAYA (MODIFICATION OF NATIONAL FORESTRY

ACT 1984) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 1(4) of the

National Forestry Act 1984 [Act 313], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Territory of Putrajaya

(Modification of National Forestry Act 1984) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2018. .

Modification of the Act to the Federal Territory of Putrajaya

2. The National Forestry Act 1984 [Act 313] is modified in the manner set out in

the Schedule.

provided)

references to the "Minister".

2. References to "State land" shall be construed as references

to the "Federal land".

3. References to "State" shall be construed as references to

the "Federal Territory of Putrajaya".

Section 2 … 1. Delete the words "or State road" from the definition of

2. Substitute for the definition of "Director" the following

published in the Gazette.".
